At home tonight — the Square: Odette, Constance; the Market: Jory, Dorian, Agnes; the Docks: Hollis, Isolde, Lian; Chapel Hill: Greta.
The Demon does not kill on the night before you arrive. It kills from night 1.

You let the evening pass.

=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I have given my life over for Agnes, should the town ever hang them."  [case board: #64]
Jory: "Look, I gotta say it—I don't trust Constance! My own reading says the people living on the Square aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #32]
Constance: "I should mention: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Odette pass by."
Constance: "I have grave doubts concerning Odette. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #65, #66]
Odette: "Miraculously, Jory and I are of one mind regarding Constance."  [case board: #67]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Gravedigger."
Hollis: "Last night, I learned that Edda, whom we hanged, was the Revenant."  [case board: #68, #69]
